about:
# SpellCoda
SpellCoda is an AddOn for World of Warcraft Classic and features a dynamic, configurable ability calculator. It implements many combat mechanics and makes use of thousands of spells, items and effects obtained from a custom generator (not public at this time), always staying up to date with client builds.

Before raising issues regarding calculator correctness, please breeze through the Discord's #info page first to help distinguish between intended behaviour and bugs.

If you clone this repository, you will need to populate the git submodule `generated`.

Releases are automatically built when there are changes in `generated` repository (from client data) or in `release-autotagged` branch.

Any problems with the generated data, whether something is missing or needs modifying, can be handled in the client variation's respective `override.lua` file, e.g. `vanilla/override.lua`.

See the project page here: https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/spellcoda

---

### Changelog overview
- Overlay labels are now grouped into categories, with more options to choose from.
- The spell catalogue has new menus for the compared spells list and more ways to sort.
- You can drag and drop items onto the calculator's item planner, and weapon skill follows the planned weapon.
- Next melee abilities (Heroic Strike and the like) show their real rage cost, and auto attack rage is counted.
- Groundwork for pet support is in, starting with Demonic Brand.
- Forever's own mana cost modifier rules are now followed, including school wide cost changes like Shadowform's.
- Forever spell resistance and penetration are reworked. The exact mechanics aren't confirmed, so a working placeholder based on community data is used for now.
- Healing crit bonus modifiers are applied correctly.
- Fixed dual wield calculations.
- Spell IDs show in tooltips on Forever while spell data is hidden in combat.
- Item tooltip icons now show for items the game hadn't loaded yet (#61).
- Fixed the overlay with Dominos 12.

### Changelog overview
- The calculator is redesigned, with a before/after result row and an item planner that shows your plan on a character model. The compared spells list moved to Tooltip → Items (`/spellcoda tooltip items`).
- Paladin seals are in, along with on hit procs in general (Windfury included).
- Armor penetration and expertise are fixed, and expertise from talents and racials now counts.
- The 1% base spell miss chance is removed on Forever.
- Custom levels now use the correct base stats for that level.
- Buffs can now be set to always be assumed, a flexible way to count raid or combat buffs you can't always see. Buffs that expire in combat are handled properly too. Set them up in Loadout → Buffs (`/spellcoda loadout buffs`).
- Stacking casts are counted correctly.
- Fixed a talent error after teleporting on Forever.
- Item tooltips refresh when you press a modifier key.
- Items with zone limited bonuses no longer count those bonuses everywhere.
